reader.requirement: At 85 the initial-state VALUE of an item associated with a variable occurrence table (a group containing it, the table itself, or a subordinate of it) is applied as though the DEPENDING ON object held the OCCURS maximum, and the object's own VALUE is placed after the table is initialized.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel >= 2023 for figurative ZERO on a numeric-edited / locale item (not ODO-specific)

reader.edition-search: grep of ImageInitializer.cs, GroupImageCodec.cs, BitImageCodec.cs, GroupValueSlicer.cs and OccurrenceRunEmit.cs for Edition|CobolVersion|DialectLevel|ConstructRegistry|IsAtLeast|DialectBehavior: none. The image composer reads VALUE clauses through ValueInitializer (its InitializerFrom DialectLevel arm is numeric-edited ZERO only, not on these paths). DataBinder.Odo.cs consults no edition.

reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb577 covers cases a, b, c and the object-after order; i5n adds a group VALUE over an ODO with the object inside it, a subordinate signed-separate element and OCCURS 0 TO with the object declared after

reader.notes: PB2337 split GroupImageCodec into GroupImageCodec (the run-time AsImage/FromImage codec), BitImageCodec and ImageInitializer (the compile-time initial-image composer); AreaImageOf, ImageInitOf and OccurrenceRunsOf moved with their bodies unchanged to ImageInitializer, wired by DataEmitter (PhysicalModel.Images) and reached from the Tier-B backing seed and GroupValueSlicer.MemberFromSlice (BackingSeedOver). Re-read at the branch head against the 1985 text. The record-struct lane (ValueInitializer.FieldInit, GroupValueSlicer.SliceInit) carries GR5 at 85; the image lane's ImageInitializer.ImageInitOf walks item.Occurs, which DataItem defines as the allocated capacity (the maximum of an ODO table), so it seeds every occurrence to the maximum too. At 85 that lane is not reachable by an ODO table: SR5 refuses one in a REDEFINES area (COBOL0855) and a VALUE in an EXTERNAL record is refused (COBOL0900), so i5n exercises the record-struct lane.

refuter.evidence: Code read independently at the branch head: ImageInitializer.cs carries AreaImageOf, ImageInitOf and OccurrenceRunsOf with no edition read (grep Edition|CobolVersion|DialectLevel|ConstructRegistry|IsAtLeast|DialectBehavior over ImageInitializer, GroupImageCodec, BitImageCodec, GroupValueSlicer, OccurrenceRunEmit: none); GroupImageCodec.cs keeps only the run-time AsImage/FromImage codec, which seeds nothing. Tried to reach the image lane with a variable occurrence table at 85: a REDEFINES over a group holding one is refused (COBOL0855, i5.cob; the 1985 text forbids it) and a VALUE in an EXTERNAL record is refused (COBOL0900, i5e.cob), so ImageInitOf's ODO arm is unreachable at 85; it walks DataItem.Occurs, documented and bound as the maximum for a format 2 OCCURS, so it would seed the maximum anyway. On the reachable lane, i5n.cob: a group VALUE "2ABCDEFGH" with its own DEPENDING ON object inside it gave N2=2 and, after MOVE 4, T2(4)=GH (the literal laid over the maximum length); OCCURS 0 TO 5 with the object VALUE 0 declared after the table gave [ZZZZZ] after MOVE 5, the object still 0 before it (its VALUE placed after the table). Cites: OK  §1985:VI.5.15.6 GR5  (5.15.6 Data Description Entries Other Than Condition-Names)  the text is in GR5; OK  §1985:VI.5.10.3 SR5  (5.10.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR5
